title: Integration test cannot reach the database service
root_cause: The job runs on the host and its test connects to 127.0.0.1:3306, but the MySQL service has no port published to the host. The refused connection makes the test and the Gradle task fail.

relevant_evidence.why: The test fails with a refused connection at its socket call.
The host job starts the service without publishing a port.
The test connects to host loopback port 3306.
